name: NGC 3749 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3749, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3749-hubble
story: NGC 3749 shows no known signs of activity at its heart, which is why astronomers use it as a control when studying especially active, luminous galaxies. Its light shows strong emission lines.

claims.text: NGC 3749 is a spiral galaxy (morphological type SA(s)a)
NGC 3749 is an emission line galaxy that displays strong emission lines
NGC 3749 is classified as inactive with no known signs of nuclear activity, and has been used as a control in studies of especially active and luminous galaxies
